title: Talking About Habits
introduction: Use the present simple to talk about regular actions.
definition: Use the present simple to talk about regular actions.
rules: Use the base verb with I, you, we and they.
With he, she or it, many verbs take -s or -es.

grammar.description: a regular action by the speaker
a regular action by one other person

examples.question: She ___ comics. (read or reads)
steps: Use reads with the singular subject she.

examples.question: They ___ football. (play or plays)
steps: Use the base verb with they.

exercises.question: She ___ comics. (read or reads)
exercises.solution: Use reads with the singular subject she.

exercises.question: They ___ football. (play or plays)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb with they.

exercises.question: I ___ my bike. (ride or rides)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb with I.

exercises.question: Mei ___ to school. (go or goes)
exercises.solution: Go takes -es with a singular third-person subject.

exercises.question: We ___ lunch at home. (eat or eats)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb with we.

summary: Use the present simple to talk about regular actions. Use the base verb with I, you, we and they.
